title: Substring with Concatenation of All Words

requirements.text: Match a concatenation of exactly all supplied words, in any permutation.
Respect the required occurrence count of every word, including duplicates.
Find overlapping matches and starts at every word-length offset.
Return every valid zero-based index once, including exact-end matches, or an empty array.

reference_complexity.auxiliary_space: O(DK) working space, excluding input and O(A) returned output
reference_complexity.notes: Reference guidance, not an analysis of the submitted program. Include stored input, returned values, JSON serialization buffers, and recursion stacks in total space. Hash-table bounds, where stated, are expected rather than worst-case guarantees. Hard follows LeetCode; the 60-minute practice estimate is provisional.
